design_name: Outcome-informed method-development benchmark for a leave-one-target-program-out CCA borrowing gate
status: frozen after all component edge outcomes were known and after Edison and Hypothesis Generation advice, but before executing this gate benchmark
claim_guard: This benchmark may show whether a fixed meta-gate can recover useful decision structure without using the held-out target programme's outcomes. Because the gate family and features were motivated after inspecting the component studies, it is method development only. It cannot provide independent positive replication, prospective validation, or discovery acceleration.
scientific_question: Can a simple credibility, compatibility, and abstention gate trained on other target programmes reduce harmful borrowing while retaining non-trivial coverage on a completely held-out programme?

estimand.edge_utility: paired relative RMSE reduction versus the target-only learner; positive values favor borrowing
estimand.decision_utility: the selected edge utility for a target task, or zero when the policy abstains
estimand.clear_harm: the edge's upper 95% interval is below zero
estimand.clear_benefit: the edge's lower 95% interval is above zero
estimand.practical_rescue: clear benefit and positive augmented-model R2 when absolute R2 is available

primary_cell_extensions.starrydata: budget 30, ExtraTrees, composition, frozen OOD quartile 4; source-specific frozen stacks only
primary_cell_extensions.tri_oer: budget 30, ExtraTrees, element_fraction, dynamic OOD quartile 4; source-specific frozen stacks on all four plates

outcome_free_features: source grouped OOF R2 clipped to -1 to 1
source credibility indicator: grouped OOF R2 greater than zero
strong physical or condition adjacency indicator

meta_gate.model: weighted Ridge regression with alpha 10 and standardized features
meta_gate.outer_split: leave one complete programme cluster out
meta_gate.training_weight: each training programme cluster has total weight one, divided equally among its edges
meta_gate.eligibility: source OOF R2 greater than zero; strong adjacency; not distant, wrong, or shuffled
meta_gate.admission: eligible and leave-one-program predicted relative RMSE gain greater than zero
meta_gate.selection: within each held-out target task select the admitted source with the highest predicted gain; abstain if none is admitted
meta_gate.fallback: zero borrowing utility, representing target-only prediction

fixed_comparators.always_best_credibility: select the non-shuffled source with the highest source OOF R2
fixed_comparators.adjacency_only: select the source with highest neighborhood score, breaking ties by source OOF R2
fixed_comparators.credibility_only: select the source with highest positive source OOF R2
fixed_comparators.cca_rule: require positive source OOF R2 and strong adjacency, reject wrong, distant, and shuffled sources, then rank by neighborhood and source OOF R2
fixed_comparators.oracle_upper_bound: select the realized best positive edge or abstain; descriptive only and never a deployable comparator

inference.within_program: average task-level decision utility and task-level harm indicators
inference.multiplicity: Holm correction over exactly the two primary contrasts using paired programme-level sign-flip randomization with the prespecified one-sided alternative that the CCA meta-gate has greater utility
inference.secondary: CCA rule, adjacency-only, credibility-only, coverage, clear-harm admission, clear-benefit retention, and available absolute R2 are descriptive

nontriviality_guard.failure: A gate below 20% programme coverage is classified as trivial abstention even if it avoids harm
